marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 30 knots except southeast 35 over southeastern
sections. Wind diminishing to east 20 near midnight and to east 15 Saturday
evening. Scattered flurries ending Saturday
morning. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 2 early
Saturday morning.<br/>
